definitions.explanation: The academic study of China, covering its language, literature, history, thought, and culture.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}で{中国学|ちゅうごくがく}を{専攻|せんこう}する。
examples.english: Major in Chinese studies at university.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{中国学|ちゅうごくがく}を{研究|けんきゅう}している。
examples.english: She does research in Chinese studies.

examples.japanese: {中国学|ちゅうごくがく}では、{古典|こてん}の{原文|げんぶん}を{読|よ}み{解|と}く{力|ちから}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: Chinese studies requires the ability to read and interpret classical texts in the original.

notes:
Composed of {中国|ちゅうごく} (China) + the suffix {学|がく} (the study of). One of many academic fields named with the ～{学|がく} pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中国学|ちゅうごくがく}を{専攻|せんこう}する: to major in Chinese studies
- {中国学|ちゅうごくがく}の{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}: a scholar of Chinese studies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {漢学|かんがく}: classical Chinese learning — the older tradition focused on Chinese classics and Confucian texts
- {東洋学|とうようがく}: Oriental studies — a broader field covering Asia as a whole
